about: The ADR 0004 pooled_arx scenario model (docs/decisions/0004-scenarios.md), as a linear decomposition: for each region, the path with both drivers held flat at their last known value (baseline_path), and the response of each of the 24 arrears months to a one-point bump of each of the 24 future driver months (sensitivity_unemployment, sensitivity_rate). The web page adds these up and runs no model code of its own (ADR 0004, 'How a path becomes arrears'). See scenario_metrics.json for whether this model is labelled a conditional forecast or illustrative.
